modules.title: 契约测试如何验证调用方与提供方的一致性
一个字段改名怎样在上线前被拦住

items.title: 失败前：双方只靠口头约定
items.text: 用户资料页读取 avatar_url 显示头像，后端重构时却把它改成 avatar。后端自己的单元测试仍可能通过，因为它不知道前端依赖旧字段；问题通常要到联调或发布后才暴露。

items.title: 补入契约并让提供方反馈
items.text: 前端用一次真实请求写下最小约定：状态码成功，响应里必须有 id、avatar_url 和 nickname，并注明需要的类型。后端在持续集成中重放场景；若字段缺失，检查应指出缺少 avatar_url 并阻止不兼容修改合并。Pact 是常见实现工具之一，不是契约测试本身的同义词。

items.title: 改善证据：先确认会失败，再恢复兼容
items.text: 验收时先故意把 avatar_url 改名，确认检查失败；再恢复旧字段或提供兼容转换，确认检查通过。这样证明测试确实能拦住这次破坏，而不只是多了一条永远通过的脚本。

modules.title: 契约测试不代替业务逻辑测试
modules.text: 契约测试只证明这组请求、响应或消息仍满足调用方的最小依赖。它不验证金额是否算对、网络是否可用、数据库副作用是否发生，也不能代替完整联调和端到端测试。

lessonPractice.title: 后端工程师准备将用户接口中的 user_id 重命名为 uid。哪种测试能以最低成本最快在 PR 合并前发现前端将被破坏？

options.label: 契约测试：根据调用方留存的接口契约校验，发现字段被重命名后在合并前自动阻断
options.feedback: 对。提供方验证会把真实响应与调用方记录的最小要求比对，并在 CI 中明确指出缺失的 user_id。

options.label: 后端单元测试：只要后端自己的业务逻辑测试通过，就假定不会影响任何外部系统
options.feedback: 不对。后端单元测试只验证后端自身逻辑，无法知道外部前端是否强依赖旧字段名。

options.label: 线上人工抽查：等代码发布到生产环境后，再由人工手动点击用户中心逐项核对
options.feedback: 不对。这属于滞后的人工验收，不能在提交代码时自动预警，且成本和风险极高。

en.title: A backend developer plans to rename user_id to uid. Which test catches this breakage fastest and cheapest before PR merge?

options.label: Contract testing: validates against consumer expectations and fails CI before code merges
options.feedback: Correct. Contract testing requires no browser orchestration or full environments, pinpointing breaking response schema changes directly.

options.label: Backend unit tests: internal logic checks pass within the isolated service without client context
options.feedback: Incorrect. Unit tests only verify internal logic and cannot detect broken external consumer assumptions.

options.label: Manual live checks: deploy the breaking change directly to production and verify the dashboard
options.feedback: Incorrect. Post-release manual checks come too late and carry massive deployment risk.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 我们前端依赖 GET /v1/users/:id 返回 id、avatar_url 和 nickname。请先根据前端真实读取的字段补一条调用方契约，再在后端 CI 中验证真实响应。验收时故意把 avatar_url 改成 avatar，确认 PR 明确提示缺少 avatar_url 且不能合并；恢复兼容字段后再确认检查通过。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Our frontend depends on GET /v1/users/:id returning id, avatar_url, and nickname. Add a consumer contract from the fields the frontend actually reads, then verify the backend response in CI. Rename avatar_url to avatar and confirm the PR reports the missing field and cannot merge; restore compatibility and confirm the check passes.

learning.assumes: You know that a page requests backend data and that renaming a field can make content disappear.
learning.outcome: You can identify consumer expectations, provider verification, and the exact CI evidence that proves a contract was broken.

modules.title: How contract testing verifies consumer and provider consistency
How one field rename gets blocked before release

items.title: Before: both sides rely on an informal agreement
items.text: The profile page reads avatar_url, while a backend refactor renames it to avatar. Backend unit tests can still pass because they do not know which response fields the frontend depends on. The breakage may surface only during integration or after release.

items.title: Add the contract and return provider feedback
items.text: A consumer test records the minimum agreement for a real request: a successful status and the required id, avatar_url, and nickname fields with their expected types. Provider verification replays the scenario in CI; if avatar_url is missing, it should name the field and block the incompatible change. Pact is one common implementation tool, not a synonym for contract testing.

items.title: Prove the guard works
items.text: For acceptance, intentionally rename avatar_url and confirm the check fails. Restore the old field or add a compatibility mapping and confirm it passes. This proves the test can catch this breakage rather than merely adding another always-green script.

modules.title: Contract testing is not business logic testing
modules.text: A contract test only proves that this request, response, or message still meets the consumer's minimum needs. It does not prove calculations, network availability, database side effects, or an entire user journey.

distinctions.label: Integration Test
distinctions.text: {c:contract-testing} verifies that consumer and provider agree on message structure without spinning up all dependencies; {c:integration-test} connects real services and databases together.

distinctions.label: End-to-End Test
distinctions.text: {c:contract-testing} isolates API schema contracts with high execution speed; {c:e2e-test} exercises the entire user journey through the full stack, carrying higher maintenance costs.
